title: Use the binomial series
text: The binomial series is $$\left(1+u\right)^r=1+r u+\frac{r \left(r-1\right)}{2} u^2$$ and so on. Use $$r=\frac{1}{3}$$ and $$u=-x$$.

title: Compute the coefficients
text: The coefficients are $$1$$, $$\frac{1}{3}$$ and $$\frac{\frac{1}{3} \left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)}{2}=\frac{-1}{9}$$. With $$u=-x$$ this gives $$1-\frac{x}{3}-\frac{x^2}{9}$$.
